description: Resizable split panel with drag, keyboard, collapse, and persistence support. The injected .split-divider is a focusable role="separator" with aria-valuenow/-valuetext

attributes.name: position
attributes.description: Default split position as a percentage (0–100). A persisted value wins over it on load. Observed (changes apply), not reflected: read the live value from the position property

attributes.name: persist
attributes.description: VBStore key suffix under namespace 'layout' (vb:layout:split:{key}); stores { position, collapsed } after user resizes and wins over the position attribute on load

attributes.name: collapsible
attributes.description: Enter or double-click on the divider collapses / expands the first panel (collapsed panel is inert; aria-valuemin becomes 0). Observed

attributes.name: data-label-collapsed
attributes.description: Divider aria-valuetext while the first panel is collapsed (otherwise "{n}%")

structure.description: First panel content (the one the divider resizes and collapses)
Second panel content — divider is auto-created between them

events.name: split-surface:resize
events.description: Fired when the split changes; source is 'pointer', 'keyboard', 'api' or 'attribute'. Not fired on initial load / reconnect

events.name: split-surface:collapse
events.description: Fired when the first panel is collapsed or expanded

properties.name: position
properties.description: Live split percentage (0 while collapsed). Settable; non-numeric values are ignored. Safe to set before the element finishes initialising (queued)

properties.name: collapsed
properties.description: Whether the first panel is collapsed. Settable (queued before init)

methods.name: reset()
methods.description: Expand, return to the position attribute (or 50), and clear the persisted value
